name: Olivia Lopes
bio: Olivia Lopes is an actress, singer, voice actress, screenwriter, and advertising professional. A graduate of ECA/USP (School of Communications and Arts at the University of São Paulo), she has extensive experience in theater and film.  Her most recent screen role is Patrizia in A Bright Lawyer (2025), directed by Alê McHaddo and produced by 44 Filmes. Previously, she played Tainá in The Park Maniac (2024), directed by Maurício Eça and produced by SANTA RITA Filmes, a hit on Prime Video.  On stage, Lopes stood out as Cinthia Minelli in Brenda Lee and the Palace of Princesses (2024), in which she also portrayed Raíssa. The musical received several major Brazilian theater awards, including the Bibi Ferreira, APCA, and DID Awards.  She was also part of the cast of  A Igreja do Diabo  (2023), directed by Guilherme Gila, a production that also received awards.  In collaboration with Gila, Lopes co-directed, co-wrote, and starred in the audiovisual adaptation of Geni e o Zepelim (Coletivo Baleia/YouTube), a work that portrays contemporary trans and travesti life in Brazil.
